body.p: A woman weaving veins. A woman is weaving veins in the evening. People fell asleep at the opposite side of the tent. Her family also fell asleep. Suddenly, while she was weaving the veins, an old woman appeared in the door. She asks the woman who is weaving the veins: "Well, you are weaving the veins, let me also bring myself a vein." Having said so, the old woman left. The woman who was making the veins got scared, she did not think for long and took out a bottle of fat from under her pillow. She smeared her family's foreheads and her own forehead with fat, but did not smear foreheads of the people from the opposite side. Then she lay down into the bed. This old woman who left after a while carries the veins of the male reindeer in the basin. She did not see anyone sitting and said: "I had a friend here, where did she go?" She entered and started palpating people's foreheads. She said: "These guys are sweating, they probably fell asleep a long time ago." She began to look at the foreheads of people on the other side of the curtain, she did not find a single sweating person there. The old woman said: "It seems that the woman who has cheated me, is [ShA:] KodÊ¼edaraxa is an unexpected form, kodÊ¼ezaraxa is expected.sleeping here". In the morning, after getting up, the woman looked into the other curtain: all the people there were killed.
